_comment: Per-platform upstream pins. Status: proposed / pinned / deferred. Keep docs/decisions/ in sync.

android.notes: Java 21 LTS, matching UMC / Minecraft requirements. No mobile port; the Bionic patch set is maintained in this repository.

ios.notes: The only maintained iOS port, tracking JDK mainline (28-dev); no tags and no 21 branch. Requires macOS + Xcode + the Gluon support zip. Whether to backport 21 is covered by ADR-0001.
